t: Look up at Centre Point, the 34-storey tower beside Tottenham Court Road station, with a lower block to the east linked to it at first-floor level. It was designed by Richard Seifert's practice, and George Marsh, a partner there, worked on the design too. Seifert also designed the NatWest Tower. The site was once occupied by a gallows, and the tower sits right over the old route of St Giles High Street, which had to be re-routed to make way for it.
